verdict.rationale: Device authorization is a fair question for an authentication service, so the axis applies. The evidence covers social OAuth providers, magic links/OTP, MFA, SAML SSO, JWTs and refresh tokens, but nothing documents an OAuth device authorization grant for CLIs or headless agents. Without that, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can authenticate CLIs and headless agents via the OAuth device authorization flow instead of pasting long-lived secrets
